criteria.name: no review wake was dispatched and no intent/stopped row exists: no wake coordinator for the Officer (documented-unsupported path)
the same human Stop on a session with NO latch returns false / writes NO marker: no durable protection is created (false inferred from the coordinator-undefined branch + absent marker)
nothing on the no-latch path CLAIMS durable protection: no fact, log line or UI state asserting "stopped"
after the no-latch Stop and one ordinary human re-engagement turn, the next review wake ACTIVATES the reviewer: a new [team-review-wake] turn starts at the model, with no marker anywhere
